newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products tumble, watch crude for direction.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products tumble, watch crude for direction.

text.p: NWE oil products were lower on Friday after a sharp crude selloff on Thursday.
Gasoline stabilized at levels about $4 below Thursday after Brent crude recovered slightly.
Naphtha also fell, losing $4 to $216.50 on Nov swaps.
Gas oil slid on weaker futures with lack of demand pushing barge diesel premiums lower and squeezing those for cargoes.
High sulphur fuel oil prices fell sharply. Cargoes were valued around $113/$115 cif NWE.
